module: rs.core.manifest.psm1 — New-Manifest(-Receipt -Shards -Plan -Layout -RunContext -TreePath [-InstructionSet]) → tree. Builds the TOC model from three small in-memory objects and renders the tree file. LANDED 2026-08-24: pure formatter over precomputed facts — offsets/lengths verbatim from the receipt, classes/groups from the plan shards (joined by Key, PlannedSizeBytes cross-checked against ByteLength), header row verbatim from the layout, provenance from RunContext; every payload-manifest declaration (#8 offset unit, #16 compaction notice, #17 encoding, oversized hazards, format identity) is a model field. Template engine kept from the LTS port; the LTS-shaped model builders replaced (rs.lts.template.ps1 at root serves LTS — airgap #3 holds, nothing imports across). tests/manifest.tests.ps1 (23).
$comment: Export phase 3 — the payload's declarations to the reader. Consumes the RECEIPT (measured offsets and byte lengths — only the writer knows), the PLAN (keys, groups, classes, oversized flags — reader hazards), and the LAYOUT (ColumnHeader from the resolved header row, not a hardcoded string). RunContext supplies provenance (RunStamp, Root, GeneratorVersion, ConfigEcho) as an opaque param, the assemble pattern — admiral has no contract yet, so its fields cannot be `from` targets. Every declaration the payload-manifest-ledger says a reader is owed (#8 offsets need their unit, #16 compaction notice, oversized-shard hazard, format identity) is a MODEL FIELD here so it is checkable, not prose. Writes exactly one file (the tree). Nothing flows back.

RunContext.note: provenance and config echo — RunStamp, Root, GeneratorVersion, ConfigEcho — read for SummaryLine / provenance lines; never hardcoded (LTS hardcoded `module`, wrongly)

InstructionSet.note: reader-directed guidance block to include (tree Instructions; the planned cognitive stdlib) — prose as functional machinery

Shards.note: the payload lines and every row's offsets

Path.note: leaf name in the Payload block

ByteLength.note: declared per shard so a reader knows the read size before reading

GroupKey.note: group name in payload lines / grouping summary

Class.note: Normal|Singleton|InBand|Oversized — Oversized → Hazards; classes summarized, not per-line noise

PlannedSizeBytes.note: cross-checked against ByteLength when both are in hand (belt and braces; serialize already asserted it)

ShardQuotaBytes.note: SummaryLine — the quota, named as a Size

ShardToleranceBytes.note: SummaryLine — quota + tolerance is the ceiling the reader may rely on, except for shards listed under Hazards

Format.note: 'psr' — format identity is declared here, not by the .txt extension

HeaderRowText.note: → ColumnHeader: the tree states the header row every shard carries, verbatim — one declaration, third sink

Model.note: what was rendered — kept in memory for tests / diagnostics; not a second artifact

Format.note: 'psr' — plus the accommodation note (files are .txt so tools read them whole)

SummaryLine.note: Grouping | GroupSort | OrderStrict | ShardQuotaBytes | ShardToleranceBytes | Created | Shards — from plan + RunContext, never preformatted upstream

PayloadLines.note: tree file first, then one line per shard: leaf name, files:N, bytes:N, group

Instructions.note: reader-directed guidance (virtual-database framing; seek by offsets; do not grep)

ColumnHeader.note: tree row metadata legend AND the psr header row verbatim (layout.HeaderRowText)

OffsetUnit.note: 'bytes, 0-based, end offsets inclusive' — payload-manifest-ledger #8, stated not implied

Compaction.note: the notice (not a cipher key): content is codec-encoded, one physical line per row, line breaks encoded — payload-manifest-ledger #16

Hazards.note: one per oversized shard; empty when none — the reader's 'every shard ≤ ceiling except these'

Provenance.note: RunStamp, Root, GeneratorVersion, ConfigEcho — from RunContext verbatim

ByteLength.note: actual size — how far over the ceiling the reader must be prepared to read whole

Reason.note: 'single record exceeds quota + tolerance; kept whole (atomicity)'
